text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
AD-DUSTOUR
- King Hussein in Jericho on Tuesday in support of President Arafat and the Palestinian Authority, says "our support for our Palestinian brothers is a principled and firm position."
- The king and the Palestinian president discuss in Amman the latest developments on the Palestinian track.
- King Hussein meets U.S. envoy Dennis Ross and Arafat.
- King phones Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, stresses need to overcome obstacles to the peace process.
- Elections for a new board of the Engineers Club takes place today with four candidates standing.
- Arrest of the killer of the 42 year old woman.
- Supply Ministry delays offers for the 150,000 tonnes wheat tender to Thursday due to a U.S. holiday.
AL-RAI
- King Hussein in "Palestine...today," the king discusses with Arafat and Ross the peace process and breaking current impasse in talks.
- Speaker of Parliament Srour protests at the insult hurled at parliament in a television programme "Hello Government" and asks for legal measures against the presenters.
JORDAN TIMES
- King visits Jericho on Tuesday after talks with Arafat: Netanyahu may join king, Arafat in self-rule city amid intense efforts to lift logjam in peace process.
- Engineer's association threatens stike over pay dispute.
AL ASWAQ
- King Hussein in the West bank on Tuesday and phones Netanyahu calling for removal of obstacles and expressing firm support for Palestinians.
- Al-Aswaq publishes proposed amendments to the civil service law.
- Formation of a publicly listed Dawliya Hotel Group company with a capital of 17 million dinars, with key shareholders.
- Deputy Prime Minister visits Palestinians injured by Israeli gunfire who are treated in Jordanian hospitals.
